{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
df['revenue_numeric'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any remaining non-numeric values
invalid_count = df['revenue_numeric'].isna().sum()

# Display the rows with invalid revenue
invalid_rows = df[df['revenue_numeric'].isna()]

print(f"Number of invalid revenue entries after conversion: {invalid_count}")
print(f"Rows with invalid revenue (first 5):\n{invalid_rows[['order_id', 'revenue']].head()}")"}
